## Batch Webpage Markdown and Links

Original by Simon at [automake.io](https://automake.io). Edit Set Page URLs, select Firecrawl Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <API key>) and run manually. Process only the first40 URLs, ten at a time, pausing one minute between groups. The source omitted Wait.unit, which defaulted to hours; the interval is now explicit. Firecrawl v2 uses markdown+links, main content, maxAge0 and30000ms scrape timeout. Each HTTP node allows3total attempts with5s gaps; retries are additional requests. Failed or malformed page stops the remaining group/list, without automatic whole-run replay. The result is returned only; no database destination is configured. See README for service/target status, allowances, quotas and source changes.
